name: Jest of Infinite Space
body:
School: Abjuration; Level: jester 6

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: Personal

Target: You

Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +5 dodge bonus to AC against ranged and area attacks.
